scope: save payload validation, explicit restore result and failure isolation, endless cleanup retry, scene-local pause reasons, read-only session presentation and configured-enemy observation

save_contract.rejected: Known restoration container/type mismatches, malformed directly consumed numeric fields, short/non-numeric vectors, non-finite serialized values, malformed pending outcome/summary and invalid supplied top-level/wave flags.
preserved_legacy: Missing optional fields and minimal player snapshots retain defaults.
Unknown saved enemy archetype uses get_profile_for_restore fallback; authored spawn references stay strict.
Old infinite-reload build versions ignore obsolete casts through the existing migration.
Role stats replaced by current templates and short legacy colors retain existing normalization.
Old saves missing role_share_initialized migrate numeric flat role shares once; newer structured states are not converted to integers.
Unticked flyby closest=INF is serialized as finite 1e30 without changing movement behavior.
save_contract.restore_failure: Validation chooses a valid backup before hydration; a failed restore reports false, marks the scene non-resumable/non-saveable, preserves both snapshots byte-for-byte, and permits returning to the menu.
save_contract.result_propagation: Player/enemy top-level hydrators return explicit success; enemy configuration completion is emitted only after successful hydrate. Existing complex ability normalization remains in place.
save_contract.cleanup: Endless committed rewards with failed run cleanup return cleanup_failed and offer retry; retry uses existing last_rewarded_run_id and does not award twice. Tier selection returns false when cleanup fails.

state_contract.pause: session_state owns independent scene-local pause reasons. Manual resume, reward completion and character close remove only their own reason; scene departure clears reasons.
state_contract.presentation: Fresh read-only scalar snapshot: mode, phase, outcome, stage_id, wave, paused, target_kind, elapsed_seconds and remaining_seconds. Music and HUD read this producer; no enemy-list scan.
state_contract.objective_time: Survival stages retain countdowns. Kill-Boss objectives display elapsed time (including stage 3 after 300 seconds) without changing clear conditions.
state_contract.enemy_lifecycle: runtime_configuration_complete + runtime_configured distinguish tree entry from completed profile/restore. Music waits for this event, preserves phase and cue lifecycle, and ignores incomplete identities.

limits: No global bus, autoload or general state machine was introduced.

No exhaustive combinations of all twenty ability effects/talents; bounded direct-index/type consumers and an active beam path were covered. New restoration fields must extend the validator and their meaningful roundtrip checks.
No global gate, Graphify update, release export or pressure benchmark was run by this worker; main agent owns the combined gate and the performance owner gets a later serial measurement window.
